# Module `process`

process - run external commands.

Thin wrappers over the runtime's `__vyb_exec_*` functions in
`runtime/vyb_runtime.c`. A full command line (with shell metacharacters,
pipelines, and redirection) is passed through `sh -c`, so callers supply
trusted command strings. `exec_run` returns the child's exit code (0..255) or
-1 if it could not be launched; `exec_output` captures stdout as a String and
records the exit status for `exec_status`.

Running a shell command reaches outside the managed model, so Vyb gates the
two executing helpers behind an explicit `freedom` block: a caller must write
`freedom { exec_run("...") }` (or `freedom { exec_output("...") }`). The
read-only `exec_status` probe stays ungated and is callable from any code.
